notes.title: RoM: patch 0.4.2
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Paladins[/h2]

[b]⚔️ Battle Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Dynamic Mech Spawning in AI Battles – AI mechs now spawn in waves, and their number depends on the number of mechs the player has. This adds more strategy to battles.
[*] Enemy Mech Counter – During battles against AI and other players, you can now see how many enemy mechs are left on the battlefield.
[*] Improved AI Bots – Bots now use active cooling, forcing a cooldown when necessary to prevent overheating.
[*] Minor server code improvements
[*] Client optimization
[/list]
[b]🎯 Combat Mechanics Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Total Miss Mechanic – Added the possibility of a complete miss and increased the overall miss chance based on community feedback.
[/list]
[b]🛠 UI and Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Player Rating Display – Clicking on your rating now shows other players’ ratings for better comparison.
[*] Bug Reporting System – Added a “Report a Bug” button. When pressed, it collects and stores all relevant event data for further analysis, making it easier to track and fix issues.
[/list]
[b]🚀 Performance & Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor Server Code Improvements – Backend optimizations for smoother gameplay.
[*] Client Optimization – Improved game performance and stability for a better player experience.
[/list]
[b]💬 Stay Connected![/b]
Thanks for being part of our community! Your feedback helps us shape the game. Don’t forget—you can always reach us and chat with other players on our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/z3EYw6MDzk]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: RoM: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes 0.4.1: A Massive Update with Exciting New Features![/b] 🚀

We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]Patch 0.4.1[/b], bringing an array of major improvements, new mechanics, and enhanced visuals to elevate your gameplay experience. Let’s break it down from the biggest changes to the finer details:

🔥 [b]Dynamic Heat Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Heat Generation[/b]: Using equipment such as weapons or utility modules will now generate heat.
[*] [b]Cooling Mechanisms[/b]: Manage heat levels with [i]passive cooling[/i] (natural cooldown over time) or equip [i]active cooling modules[/i] for immediate heat reduction.
[*] [b]Overheat Consequences[/b]: If a mech overheats, it becomes temporarily [i]disabled[/i], unable to move, shoot, or interact.

[*] [b]Cooling Strategies[/b]:
[list]
[*] Leave your mech idle for a turn to let it naturally cool down.
[*] Install [i]active cooling modules[/i] in the universal mount slot for faster cooldown during crucial moments.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/74f3d28604818c61725c753e9d622ec4f01941cf.png[/img]
This new system adds depth to tactical gameplay, encouraging strategic planning and resource management during intense battles.



🤖 [b]Repair Functionality on the Battlefield[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]No More Stranded Mechs[/b]: The new [i]Repair Drone[/i] brings mechs back into action by fixing destroyed or heavily damaged modules.
[*] [b]Repair Capability[/b]: The drone can restore your mech’s functionality, enabling tactical movement even after heavy damage.
[*] [b]Installation[/b]: The Repair Drone occupies a [i]universal mount slot[/i], making it a versatile addition to your loadout.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/04cd215cec622869bfb33c16a27757d546cac232.png[/img]
This feature ensures that even in the heat of battle, your mechs can recover and rejoin the fight, adding new layers of strategy.



⚔️ [b]Core Turn-Based Strategy Mechanic[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]How It Works[/b]: If your mech encounters an enemy while executing a move command, its movement will immediately halt.
[*] [b]Player Choice[/b]: You’ll then have the freedom to decide the next action—whether to attack, reposition, or retreat.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/e27858517051694f4093235209f128db7d877fcc.png[/img]
This mechanic adds a dynamic element to battles, requiring adaptability and quick decision-making.


✨ [b]Enhanced Aesthetics and Immersion[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Cell Visuals[/b]: Improved clarity and aesthetics for better tactical planning.
[*] [b]Model Upgrades[/b]: Refined graphical details for mechs and equipment.
[*] [b]Map Enhancements[/b]: Subtle visual updates to maps for a richer gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Overall Polish[/b]: Minor tweaks and adjustments to make the game more visually appealing and immersive.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/a2432a4333a15b18673c2792e708b8d25e6ca01e.png[/img]


⚡ [b]Performance Boosts and Stability[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Client Optimizations[/b]: Expect smoother performance and improved frame rates during gameplay.
[*] [b]Network Enhancements[/b]: Optimized server-client communication for a more stable and seamless multiplayer experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/1224f9fff6fcec4f1f47249308dc3b53592d77fb.png[/img]
These technical improvements ensure the game runs efficiently, even during intense battles.



[b]💬 Join the Discussion![/b]
Connect directly with our [b]developers[/b] and [b]product owner[/b] on [url=https://discord.com/invite/z3EYw6MDzk]Discord[/url] to share your feedback, ask questions, and discuss ideas together.

[b]🛡️ The Arenas Await![/b]

notes.title: RoM: Patch 0.3.4
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]brave pilots[/b]! We are thrilled to unveil our [b]RoM: Patch 0.3.4[/b]:

[list]
[*] Desert River Map: Explore the picturesque Desert River in both day and night settings. Navigate its treacherous terrain and discover hidden secrets under the changing skies.
[*] In-Game Chat Enhancement: Engage in tactical discussions and taunts with your opponents using the newly enhanced in-game chat feature. Coordinate your moves, exchange banter, and outwit your foes on the battlefield.
[*] Two-Phase Visualization: Gain tactical advantage with the newly added two-phase visualization. Now, users can assess the maximum distance they can reach before executing a shot, empowering precision and strategic gameplay.
[*] Mech Management Made Easy: Introducing the 'Repair All Mechs' and 'Recharge All Mechs' buttons for streamlined mech maintenance. Keep your arsenal in top condition with just a click, ensuring peak performance on the battlefield.
[*] Various bug fixes and visual enhancements to enhance overall gameplay experience.
[/list]

For any feedback feel free to join our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/z3EYw6MDzk]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: RoM: Hotfix 0.3.1.175
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/9b401d2f50dc08df9370276a3358461123179bca.png[/img][h3]Greetings, Pilots![/h3]
We are thrilled to announce the arrival of our inaugural post-release hotfix update, version 0.3.1.175. Below, you'll find a comprehensive list of enhancements:
[list]
[*] The artificial intelligence underwent retraining based on post-release gameplay, eliminating instances of AI freezing in place.
[*] In light of the AI retraining, it now demonstrates improved capabilities such as lifting containers with drops, utilizing cover effectively, and executing tactical retreats.
[*] Addressed a bug causing server response desynchronization and animation discrepancies. This ensures a seamless experience, preventing situations where, for instance, the death animation precedes the impact animation of a mech.
[*] Revamped the display of damage dealt for a more intuitive and engaging experience.
[*] Introduced subtle modifications to the cover system for enhanced gameplay dynamics.
[*] Undertook a comprehensive rework of weapon balance to fine-tune the gaming experience.
[*] Overhauled the balance related to weapon and module usage, specifically addressing overheating issues.
[*] We've streamlined the game selection process. Currently, players can no longer choose between a game with another player or artificial intelligence. There's now a single button: players enter the queue. If the matchmaking system doesn't find an opponent within 30 seconds, the player is seamlessly matched with artificial intelligence.
[*] Optimizations and minor fixes to refine overall performance.
[/list] 

Thank you for your continued support, join our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/z3EYw6MDzk]Discord[/url] to talk to our team, discuss upcoming updates and events and leave your feedback.

notes.title: Rage of Mechs: Alpha Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398934/40bc4e55a8db7f84c5927cc23635449bccf53cb3.png[/img]
[h2]Greetings, Survivors![/h2]

Today marks an incredibly special milestone for CPCS. We're excited to share that, despite not being professional game developers with any prior experience in the field, we've passionately embarked on an extraordinary journey in game development.

Our debut title, "Rage of Mechs," began as a modest pet project, crafted by just three enthusiasts in our spare time. This small endeavor has since blossomed, and our team has expanded significantly. After about two years of dedicated work, overcoming numerous challenges, and a steep learning curve, we're thrilled to unveil our first public alpha version, which is going to be released soon!

Please note, this alpha release primarily serves as a Proof of Concept. It includes only the basic mechanics of the game. However, we're eager to share it with the world, gather your valuable feedback, and start building a vibrant community around it. We're brimming with ideas that we aim to implement in the future.

So, if you're ready to embark on this adventure with us, we invite you to purchase a ticket to our exclusive community. It's more than just access to the Alpha version of our game; it's an opportunity to become an integral part of our journey. Along with the game, you'll gain access to our official Discord server, where you can engage directly with the team and fellow players.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/z3EYw6MDzk]Join us[/url] in shaping "Rage of Mechs," and let's grow and evolve this experience together!
